newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers well-supported by cargo levels.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers well-supported by cargo levels.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted around Wednesday levels, and were likely to stay firm as cargo prices were strong, traders said.

At midday, bunker 180-cst was quoted at between $120-$122 by independents and at 380-cst at $115-$118. Majors were quoting $119-$120 for cst 380 supplies. Prices were hovering around Wednesday levels at $117-$120 for cst 380 and at $123-$125 for cst 180. "Demand was average," said a broker.
MDO was quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil at $220--$225. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
